description: Every data file the toolkit reads, with its SHA-256. Files with a url can be downloaded with `vmsspatial fetch-data`; files without one are copied from a research workspace with `--from-workspace` (raw audit inputs).

files.note: The study transcription: 34,977 paragraph-text tokens in 4,130 lines (ZL transliteration, uncertain-reading tokens omitted).
Physical structure of every page: quire, leaf, side, bifolium, partner leaf, section, Currier language, hand.
The manuscript bundle: every page and locus by bifolium, strict geometry in the recorded warp state, with the review block.

Ink measurements on the Beinecke scans (vmsspatial.ink): per located rectangle of the sensitivity bundle the extent, angle, x-height band, ascender, descender and flags, per line the robust fit; recorded frame; keyed by token id and (page, locus).
Baseline points per token under the four methods (bottom, centre, glyph, ink), recorded warp state, with the words and geometry digests of the sensitivity bundle (vmsspatial.baselines.build_table).

The page warp (vmsspatial.warp): per page the fitted shared warp field, per-line leave-one-out coefficients, tilt line, the baseline it was fitted on and the quality; apply with warp.apply / warp.transform / load_bundle(warp='flat').
Registration of the recorded frame to the page images (vmsspatial.images): per page and source the matrix, residual field, per-line shifts and quality. Numbers only.
Coverage of the recorded rectangles per page and locus type: ZL tokens, located tokens under both policies, orientation kinds, detected boxes, and why a token has no usable box.

The wheels of the circular text (vmsspatial.wheels): per page the accepted wheels (centre, radius, rings with their fits and member tokens, nearby labels) and the rejected circular loci with reasons; recorded frame and warp state (fRos detected).
The leaves on the parchment (vmsspatial.leaves): per page the fold, the top and bottom edges and the scale in mm, measured on the Beinecke scans or estimated, in the recorded frame. Numbers only.

Ruler-calibrated photographic projections of curved f1r/f8r leaves, recorded text-registration check and existing warp summaries. Supplementary evidence; not flattened physical ground truth or revised copy placements.

note: Shipped entries travel with the repository; optional entries (optional: true) are referenced by their published URL or their path in the research workspace and are never published (publish.py skips them). The toolkit reads an optional file when it is present and never requires one.
